basics.name: Kevin Rask
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Architect
basics.summary:
Kevin Rask is a senior software engineer with extensive skills in designing, creating, and maintaining software solutions that handle large amounts of data and have high availability requirements.

Whether the target is to take over a large legacy system or create a sophisticated modern web solution for large scale usage, Kevin is the right man for the job. He has been working in different areas of business including Finance, Banking, Logistics, Gaming Industry and Telecom, with tech stacks ranging from embedded systems to databases and modern web solutions.
basics.x-tagline: Building software that is easy to maintain is a craft of its own. You learn it by having supported such systems yourself, and by knowing the tools that help along the way.

x-strengths.title: Backend software developer
x-strengths.description: Kevin has extensive experience in backend development, especially in Java and .NET environments.

x-strengths.title: DevOps engineer
x-strengths.description: With a lot of experience in DevOps work, Kevin is the right person for taking over an existing solution.

x-strengths.title: Metrics
x-strengths.description: In order to make solutions maintainable, metrics play a crucial part. Kevin has lots of experience in planning a supportable application.

x-keyRoles.title: Web developer
x-keyRoles.description: Architecting and developing many different applications and systems through the years, mainly web applications, but familiar also with desktop and embedded software development. Familiar with many different databases, both relational and key/value based. Maintaining cloud infra as infrastructure as code.

x-keyRoles.title: Support engineer
x-keyRoles.description: Lots of experience in the whole lifespan of a software, starting from architecture and planning into development, testing and deployment and finally to maintenance, monitoring and incident management. This experience is crucial in building robust and maintainable applications.
